hooks.text: 触碰友军史莱姆扩张贪吃蛇式队伍
hooks.excerpt: In the combat gameplay of this game, players will play as the snake head. In each battle, friendly units will appear one by one. Players must touch them to have them join their team, just like in the game of Snake, making the team longer and longer.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 随机史莱姆能力重组每场队伍
hooks.excerpt: Each slime has its own unique ability, and all the slimes that appear are random, so the team players assemble each time is different, providing a different experience every time.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 从对话线索拼回妻子的记忆
hooks.excerpt: In the storyline gameplay of this game, players need to carefully observe and listen, gather information from every sentence of the dialogue, piece together their wife's memories, and thus find their wife who is lost in the dream of memories.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
